eras.title: The empty bazaar
eras.caption: Long rows of stone-pillared pavilions mark a bazaar at Vijayanagara, now known through the ruins of Hampi. Beyond them, temples and granite hills place the market within a much larger capital, where commerce and ceremonial life shared the same streets.
